name: Stagehand
description: Browser automation SDK that mixes code with natural-language act, extract and observe steps and includes an autonomous agent mode.
whatItDoes: Gives developers a way to write browser automations where some steps are deterministic code and others are plain-language instructions resolved by an LLM. It also offers an agent that completes a whole task from a single instruction.
howItWorks: The SDK launches or attaches to a Chrome browser and exposes primitives for acting, extracting structured data and observing possible actions. Each primitive sends page context to a model and turns the answer into concrete browser operations. It can run locally or against Browserbase's hosted browsers, with packages for TypeScript, Python and Go.
